# Watershed analysis report

*Generated by 07_Statistics.ipynb. All numbers come from the files listed in `07_output_manifest.csv`.*

## Basin
- Area **11,873 km²**, perimeter 906 km, longest flowpath 422 km
- Form factor 0.07, circularity ratio 0.18 (elongated basin)
- Elevation 184 to 8,141 m, mean 2,797 m, relief 7,957 m
- Hypsometric integral 0.33; mean slope 28.1°; 44 % of the basin is steeper than 30°

## Drainage network (threshold 5 km²)
- Drainage density 0.33 km/km², stream frequency 0.069 per km², maximum Strahler order 5
- Weighted bifurcation ratio 4.42. Drainage figures depend on the threshold.

## Land use, soil and runoff
- Tree cover 51 %; bare ground, snow and ice 28 %
- Basin curve number (AMC II, snow and ice excluded) 73
- CN describes rainfall-runoff only. Units flagged `cn_caution` have 25 % or more snow and ice.

## Main river
- Length 418 km, drop 5,448 m, mean gradient 0.0130 m/m, sinuosity 2.02
- 9 knickzones and 445 bends detected; the largest 5 km gross head is 422 m
- Hydropower figures are screening values: head comes from the DEM, flow is a placeholder, so treat power as indicative only

## Subcatchments
- 36 units, median area 323 km², largest 854 km²
- Highest screening scores (rank-based, not a hazard model): unit 10 (77), unit 33 (66), unit 12 (65), unit 29 (65), unit 31 (65)

## Data and caveats
- DEM: `kali44N.tif`, reprojected to UTM 44N, 29.5 m cells; conditioned with least-cost breaching (reach 250 cells)
- Land cover: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
- Soil: SoilGrids 2.0 (ISRIC), CC-BY 4.0; hydrologic soil groups are derived from texture (no depth to bedrock), so they are approximate
- CN values are assumptions from TR-55-style tables and are listed in `Inputs/cn_lookup.csv`
- Time-of-concentration formulas were calibrated on small catchments; use them as order-of-magnitude only
- Audit: see `07_consistency_checks.csv`
